content: आवेशः .²1 Entering into, entrance; आवेशं कृ <ls>Pt. 1</ls> to enter or infuse oneself into. .²2 Taking possession of, influence, exercise; स्मय˚ influence of pride <ls>R. 5. 19</ls>; so मदन˚, क्रोध˚, भय˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Intentness, devotedness to an object, complete absorption in one wish or idea. .²4 Pride, arrogance. .²5 Flurry, agitation, anger, passion; <ls>K. 291</ls>. .²6 Demoniacal possession. .²7 Apoplectic or epileptic giddiness.
